messages.author: 0c6ed9804f9b0c5b
messages.subject: mirt 5PL
parts:
Dear Phil

I am trying to use mirt for a 5PL model using simulated data. The item parameters were successfully estimated, the results are as follows:
      a            b           g u S
Item1 0.37169114  -3.8096963   0 1 6.8778962
Item2 0.40838015   0.4090794   0 1 1.8008279
Item3 -0.42904420 -2.9667259   0 1 1.0551531
...

However, fit items cannot be calculated, and the results are as follows:
item    S_  X2 df.S_X2 RMSEA.S_X2 p.S_X2
1 Item1 NaN    0       NaN        NaN
2 Items NaN    0       NaN        NaN
3 Item3 NaN    0       NaN        NaN

Why ?

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: mirt 5PL
parts:
How many items are in your test? This looks like you have just three, which is not enough information given the number of parameters and degrees of freedom of the reduced total scores used in S-X2.

Phil
